provenance: Agent-authored synthetic Indonesian examples for a small diagnostic benchmark. Not real project posts, not expert-validated ground truth, and not a representative accuracy estimate.
label_policy: Classify the author's expressed emotional tone, not support for a person, bot likelihood, or claim truth. Quoted sentiment is not automatically the author's stance. Insufficient context or unresolved mixed tone has no gold label and needs human review.

cases.text: gila sih, adminnya gercep bgt! masalah gue kelar 5 menit, makasih ya 🙌
cases.rationale: Informal intensifier accompanies explicit praise and gratitude.

cases.text: duh aplikasinya ngehang mulu, udh nyoba 3x tetep gagal. kesel bgt.
cases.rationale: Repeated failure and explicit frustration; abbreviations do not alter the tone.

cases.text: info aja gaes, loket buka jam 8, tutup jam 3 sore.
cases.rationale: Informal factual announcement without expressed evaluation.

cases.text: Wah hebat banget pelayanannya, nunggu tiga jam cuma buat disuruh balik besok 🙃
cases.rationale: Praise conflicts with a concrete complaint; the author is sarcastic.

cases.text: Mantap, update baru malah bikin semua draft hilang. Inovasi yang sangat membantu ya.
cases.rationale: Loss of drafts makes the ostensible praise ironic.

cases.text: Katanya ribet, eh ternyata dua klik beres. Ribet banget ya sampai aku nggak sempat ngeluh 😂 makasih tim!
cases.rationale: Ironic complaint is resolved by successful completion and explicit gratitude.

cases.text: Dalam rapat, peserta berkata, 'Layanannya buruk.' Kalimat itu tercatat di halaman dua notulen.
cases.rationale: The author reports a negative quote without adopting its judgment.

cases.text: Iklannya bilang 'paling cepat'. Pengalaman saya justru lambat dan mengecewakan.
cases.rationale: The author's explicit dissatisfaction overrides quoted promotional praise.

cases.text: Ada yang bilang 'jelek', tapi saya puas sekali: hasilnya rapi dan sesuai pesanan.
cases.rationale: The author explicitly rejects the quoted criticism and expresses satisfaction.

cases.text: Finally beres juga! The team was super helpful, beneran bikin lega.
cases.rationale: Indonesian and English both express praise and relief.

cases.text: Not worth it sih, mahal tapi kualitasnya poor banget. Nyesel beli.
cases.rationale: Both languages express negative evaluation and regret.

cases.text: Meeting di-reschedule ke Friday jam 10. Link tetap sama.
cases.rationale: Code-switching conveys scheduling facts, not emotional evaluation.
Without context, this could be sincere praise or sarcasm.

cases.text: Desainnya bagus, tapi sering error. Ya begitulah.
cases.rationale: Positive design and negative reliability are unresolved; no forced overall gold label.
The author's response may be agreement, doubt, or irony; attribution alone does not resolve it.
